description:
Connect your Pipedrive CRM data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions about deals and leads created within a chosen date range.

Compare record counts and values across periods, explore current deal status, and group deals by pipeline, stage or owner identifiers. See daily creation trends and keep values separated by currency.

Reports filter records by creation date. Deal status and value reflect the returned records; they are not historical snapshots or a report of everything closed during that period.

defaultPrompt: How many Pipedrive deals were created last week?
Generate a monthly Pipedrive pipeline report covering the last 30 days
Break down my Pipedrive deals by stage for the last 14 days

positive.description: Start a fresh conversation with this Pipedrive plugin enabled and a reviewer account that can access Pipedrive Demo. Use Data Mode only. Resolve relative dates when the case runs and state the inclusive dates. If access is unavailable, explain the access issue; do not silently switch workspaces. Monthly deal creation and value, with multiple currencies.
positive.prompt: How many Pipedrive deals were created last month in Pipedrive Demo, and what is their total value?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve last month to the complete previous calendar month. Request metrics Deals and Deal value with breakdown Deal currency and omit time_granularity. Report the count and summed deal value for each returned currency. Counts may also be totaled across currencies. Label the value as deal value, not recognized revenue or money collected. Use only assorted_requests.pipedrive_request and workspace_name Pipedrive Demo. Read the header and rows in structuredContent.reportingData.Pipedrive.data.Deals and surface any note_of_assumption. All date ranges select records by creation date; status, stage and value reflect the returned current records, not a historical snapshot. Keep monetary values separated by Deal currency. Return a clear no-data answer if the result is empty. Do not open a widget or invent fields, rows, names or values.
